emptyRoot.description: Whether to reject an empty object-form schema.

bareArrayRoot.description: Whether to reject an object-form schema that only asserts an array type.

nonArrayRootType.description: Whether to reject an object-form schema that excludes arrays.

nonConstrainingRoot.description: Whether to reject an object-form schema with no array-applicable keyword.

ignoredKeywords.description: Whether to reject keywords ignored by ESLint’s configured Ajv.

ignoredRefSiblings.description: Whether to reject constraint siblings ignored beside $ref.

unresolvedRefs.description: Whether to reject references ESLint cannot resolve.

ignoredAdditionalItems.description: Whether to reject additionalItems when items is not tuple-form.

incompatibleTypeKeywords.description: Whether to reject keywords incompatible with the declared type.

impossibleBounds.description: Whether to reject contradictory minimum and maximum bounds.
